description: This Dart source file defines the CatalogService class, which provides methods for interacting with backend API endpoints related to categories and books, including fetching lists with pagination and filters, and retrieving individual book details.

classes.name: CatalogService
classes.description: A singleton class providing methods to fetch categories and books data from API endpoints.

methods.name: fetchCategories
methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of categories with optional search query.

methods.name: fetchBooks
methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of books with optional filters including search query, category, price range.

methods.name: getBook
methods.description: Retrieves a single book by its ID.
